correctness.rationale: Contraction consistency from strong density and centering forces acyclic pairwise-choice tournaments: a selected winner from a triple beats both alternatives, ruling out all 3-cycles. Every choice is the minimum of the unique induced total order. Under strong density, the post-selected-world ranking agrees on every selected suffix by two-point comparisons; the four-distinct-world condition is sufficient to compare minima on all nested nonempty sets. Independently enumerated all 1296 centered ranking profiles at size four and directly tested all (w,A,C), obtaining 138 strong-dense and exact equivalence with the four-point test; sizes 1,2,3 give 1,1,8.
